name: Front-to-Back Ray Casting with Iso-value Thresholding
aliases: Standard Ray Casting with Iso-value Thresholding
definition: A volume rendering technique that casts rays through a 3D volume, sampling density values, and blending color and opacity front-to-back only when the sampled density exceeds a specific iso-value threshold.
summary: Front-to-Back Ray Casting with Iso-value Thresholding is a direct volume rendering technique that restricts color and opacity accumulation to samples exceeding a specific density threshold, acting as a filter unlike standard ray casting.
